(An Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Govt. of India) NOTICE INVITING TENDER FOR Development of ICT-Enabled Audio-visual Studio Room (Recording Equipment, Furniture, and Associated Infrastructure Works) 1. Introduction ABV-Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management (IIITM) Gwalior is an Institute of National Importance as per the IIIT Act of the Government of India. It is a Centrally Funded Techni cal Institute fully funded by the Ministry of Education, Government of India. Atal Bihari Vajpayee Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management (ABV-IIITM), Gwa lior, invites bids for the complete Supply, Installation, Testing, and Commissioning (SITC) for the D evelopment of ICT-Enabled Audio-visual Studio Room. The overall objective is to develop a profess ionally equipped, acoustically treated and technology-enabled studio capable of supporting high-q uality 4K video recording, lectures, presentations, professional video production, interactive sessio ns, online programmes and live streaming, with integrated audio-visual control and recording facil ities. The Institute invites Bids/Tenders from various organizations/bidders for the above-mentioned wor k. The interested bidders/organizations may submit their Bids/Tenders in the prescribed format, duly completed, along with the requisite enclosures/documents. Incomplete Bids/Tenders will not be considered for evaluation. The Institute reserves the right to accept or reject any or all Bids/Tenders without assigning any re ason. 2. Scope of Work

2.1 Overview The bidder/OEM shall undertake the complete aforementioned work at ABV-IIITM Gwalior on a tur nkey basis. The work encompasses the following major components: A. Audio-Visual and Interactive Classroom Infrastructure: Installation of professional audio equip ment, including active speakers, wireless lapel microphones, gooseneck microphones, a 75-inch interactive flat panel, a 43-inch smart display, digital audio mixer, HDMI multi-view switcher, co ntrol processor, control GUI and PoE network switch. B. Professional Video Recording and Production Setup: Installation of 4K PTZ tracking cameras, professional studio cameras, LED video lights, softboxes, green screen backdrop, studio telepro mpter, professional headphones, laptop and high-performance video editing workstation. C. Live Streaming and Media Management: Provision of professional vMix live streaming software , media station for multi-source 4K video capture, mixing, switching, recording and streaming, d ual HDMI-to-USB video capture equipment, and associated cabling and accessories. D. Power and Equipment Infrastructure: Installation of a 5 KVA online UPS with battery backup, s urge protection, customized equipment rack, HDMI transmitters/receivers and camera mountin g arrangements. E. Acoustic Treatment and Interior Development: Acoustic wall panelling, acoustic false ceiling, g ypsum/drywall partitions, sound-controlled air-conditioning, LED lighting, concealed electrical wi ring and floor carpeting. F. Furniture and Ancillary Facilities: Provision of customized motorized presenter table and chair, computer desks and chairs, sofa, centre table, wardrobe modifications, wall-mounted fan and fi re safety equipment. 2.2 Scope of Work for supply, installation, testing commissioning and warranty 1. The bidder/OEM shall supply all equipment, materials, accessories and associated components as specified in the Schedule of Requirements (Annexure-C), conforming to the detailed technica l specifications mentioned in the respective annexures. 2. All equipment supplied must be brand new, unused, fully functional and operable, conforming to the specifications and requirements of this tender. No refurbished, used or end-of-life produc ts shall be accepted. 3. The work shall be executed on a turnkey basis. All components, accessories, connectors, cable s, mounting arrangements and other items necessary for making the studio fully operational at the designated location shall be supplied, installed and commissioned within the quoted price. 4. Annexure A- Description of Major Equipment 1. Integrated Audio System Speakers The speaker system should deliver exceptional sound quality. Should have a Built-in Digital Signal Processor (DSP) that ensures a powerful, clear sound experience. The system should include a stereo amplifier capable of delivering at least 2 x 40 watts of power. I t should support both balanced and unbalanced stereo line inputs for compatibility with various au dio sources, from 3.5 mm jack connectors to terminal block inputs for longer, interference free sig nal runs. Should include volume control and two tone adjustments for treble and bass. Should have flexible installation capabilities to be installed on with brackets that support both hori zontal and vertical mounting, allowing up to 45° inclination. Additionally, it should have capabilitie s to be installed in corners or on ceilings, with an optional mounting bracket providing up to 90° ex tra inclinations. For safety, the unit should include M6 drop protection.

(Active Wall Speakers) Key Features required: · 2 Way Speaker System: Active and passive units with 5 ¼” woofer and ½” tweeter for High Qu ality audio. · Integrated DSP: Delivers clear, powerful sound for various applications. · Stereo Amplifier: Provides 2 x 40 watts of power. · Flexible Inputs: Balanced and unbalanced stereo line inputs, including 3.5 mm jack and termin al block. · Tone Control: Two band equalizers for treble and bass adjustments. · Auto Standby Mode: Reduces power consumption when no signal is detected. · Flexible Mounting: Horizontal/vertical installation with 45° inclination; optional 90° bracket avai lable. · Safety Features: Equipped with M6 drop safety protection. · Remote Input Expansion: RJ45 connector allows connection to optional remote input modules. Wireless Lapel Microphone To enhance audio experience with this wireless system paired with a high-performance cardioid co ndenser lavalier microphone. It should facilitate presentations, lectures, theatre performances, or on-the-go broadcasting, with clear, professional sound quality and ease of use.

(Wireless Lapel Microphone) Key Features required: · Crystal-Clear Audio: Delivers exceptional sound fidelity, ensuring every word is captured wit h precision. · Cardioid Lavalier Microphone: Effectively reduces background noise and focuses on the us er's voice, ideal for noisy environments. · Wireless Freedom: Offers seamless mobility without compromising audi quality, perfect for dynamic presentations and performances. · Lightweight Beltpack Design: Compact and ergonomic, providing comfort for extended use . · Wide Compatibility: Connects effortlessly with various sound systems and devices. Modular Microphone System Modular microphone system is required for professional sound reinforcement and should include a condenser microphone element, gooseneck, and a choice of different power modules, along with c lamp and shock mount.
